passages.text:
Hi Elisa,
Attached is a version of the electoral cybersecurity paper with our suggested edits and comments. Could you please
share this with IFES today, and we can then discuss it with them on Monday? You can also flag for them that we have a
few broader comments to discuss with them about this, as well as more fleshed-out thinking on the next document to be
produced under this activity.
Thanks, and have a good weekend!
Best,
Michael
Michael McNulty
Senior Advisor, Democratic Elections and Political Processes (DEPP)
Center for Democracy, Human Rights, and Governance (DRG Center)
USAID
1300 Pennsylvania Ave. NW, Washington, D.C. 20523
